understand.concept: Debugging asi Program-na expected oiba matung inna thabak toude maduda adugi behaviour yengsinba, asol karan khangba, matik chaba correction touba amasung amuk test touba process-ni. Problem Decomposition asi maru oiba thabak adu clear responsibility leiba macha-macha parts-da khainaba-ni.
understand.whyItMatters: Files kayamathangda amukna change touba matamda karigumba change-na problem solve toukhibage haiba khangba yadaba. Macha parts amam amam yengsinba-na confusion amasung unnecessary changes khanghanba ngammi.

Evidence adugi matung inna Hypothesis ama semsin, focused change ama tou amasung retest tou. Adudagi related Features-su test tou.
